en.summary: Pleurisy is inflammation of the lung lining causing sharp chest pain worse on breathing or coughing. NHS: see a GP — causes vary and need assessment. Emergency if severe breathlessness, coughing blood, sudden one-sided swelling with chest pain (possible clot), or cardiac red flags. Do not invent anti-inflammatory regimens.
emergencyIf: Sudden chest pain with one-leg swelling (possible PE/DVT pathway)
seeDoctorIf: Sharp chest pain worse on breathing or coughing
doNot: Do not assume 'just a muscle strain' without assessment when pain is pleuritic

fr.summary: La pleurésie donne une douleur thoracique aiguë à l'inspiration. Avis médical. Urgence si dyspnée sévère, hémoptysie, signes d'infarctus/embolie. Pas d'AINS inventés.

he.summary: דלקת צדר: כאב חד בחזה שמחמיר בנשימה. ייעוץ רפואי. חירום בקוצר נשימה חמור, דם, סימני התקף לב/תסחיף. אין NSAID מומצא.

ru.summary: Плеврит: острая боль в груди хуже на вдохе. К врачу. Неотложка при тяжёлой одышке, крови, признаках инфаркта/ТЭЛА. НПВП не выдумывать.
